hypothesis: Retaining more L-BFGS curvature pairs may improve finite-budget progress on the unchanged training objective. No superiority is assumed.
capacity_gate: unchanged: last accepted iterate captures at least 90% of zero-start mean-response energy; nonfinite/abnormal termination cannot pass.
primary_comparison: Last accepted training MSE after termination within each 201-evaluation budget; report both failures and budget/convergence status.
secondary_comparison: Best accepted MSE, full trial and accepted histories, active-gradient norms and independent replay/numerical controls. No held-out observations.
prefix_check: Both initial checkpoints must reproduce parent MSE; compare the first 20 accepted updates and associated trial metrics within absolute 1e-10, since the history limit has not yet discarded old correction pairs. Report a mismatch before attributing differences to memory length.
history_policy: Both reset curvature history from the same endpoint; neither resumes the 1001-evaluation optimizer state or represents an independent initialization.
timing_policy: Runs may execute concurrently. Equal objective-evaluation budgets are compared; elapsed times are not controlled performance measurements.
failure_policy: Keep existing hard evaluation limits and nonfinite failure retention. No silent retry, budget extension or dynamical changes.
